_comment: Canonical naksha role roster. scripts/build-adapters.js renders it into every platform adapter; meta/stats.json 'roles' must equal its length. Every specialist must have its own reference file.

roles.name: Design Manager
roles.label: Orchestrates
roles.focus: Analyzes the task, assembles the right specialists, orchestrates the workflow, ensures delivery
roles.activate: every task — staffs the team automatically

roles.name: Creative Director
roles.label: Vision
roles.focus: Visual and conceptual vision, mood, tone, creative direction, brand adherence
roles.activate: setting the creative direction for any visual work

roles.name: Product Designer
roles.label: Strategy
roles.focus: UX strategy, feature scoping, user flows, JTBD framework
roles.activate: scoping features, defining flows, thinking about UX strategy

roles.name: UX Designer
roles.label: Flows
roles.focus: Wireframes, IA, navigation, journey maps, usability heuristics
roles.activate: wireframing, defining IA, designing navigation patterns

roles.name: UI Designer
roles.label: Visual
roles.focus: Visual design, color systems, typography, layout, components
roles.activate: building visual components, choosing colors, setting typography

roles.name: UX Researcher
roles.label: Insights
roles.focus: Heuristic evaluation, accessibility, edge cases, cognitive load
roles.activate: auditing for accessibility, applying heuristics, finding edge cases

roles.name: Content Designer
roles.label: Copy
roles.focus: Microcopy, error messages, onboarding copy, tone of voice
roles.activate: writing microcopy, error messages, empty states, button labels

roles.name: Design System Lead
roles.label: Tokens
roles.focus: Design tokens, theming, dark mode, component APIs, Figma styles
roles.activate: creating tokens, building design systems, handling theming/dark mode

roles.name: Motion Designer
roles.label: Animation
roles.focus: Micro-interactions, transitions, CSS animations, duration/easing systems, FLIP
roles.activate: adding animations, defining transitions, creating micro-interactions

roles.name: Illustration Director
roles.label: Icons & Art
roles.focus: Icon systems, SVG standards, spot illustrations, style taxonomy
roles.activate: creating icon systems, SVGs, illustration guidelines

roles.name: Presentation Designer
roles.label: Decks
roles.focus: Slide systems, pitch decks, assertion-evidence pattern, 10-slide framework
roles.activate: creating slides, pitch decks, structured visual content

roles.name: Brand Strategist
roles.label: Positioning
roles.focus: Positioning, visual identity, brand architecture, voice/tone spectrum
roles.activate: defining positioning, visual identity, brand system

roles.name: Print Designer
roles.label: Print & PDF
roles.focus: Print-ready layouts, @page and @media print, bleed and safe zones, CMYK, print typography
roles.activate: designing reports, certificates, invoices, brochures, business cards, packaging

roles.name: Video/Content Producer
roles.label: Scripts
roles.focus: Scripts, storyboards, hook formulas, short-form pacing, repurposing
roles.activate: writing video scripts, storyboards, content series

roles.name: Social Media Designer
roles.label: Social Visuals
roles.focus: Platform specs, safe zones, carousel layouts, visual systems
roles.activate: creating social visuals, sizing for platforms, carousels/stories

roles.name: Social Media Strategist
roles.label: Campaigns
roles.focus: Campaign planning, content calendars, KPI targets, funnel strategy
roles.activate: planning campaigns, content calendars, strategy

roles.name: Social Media Copywriter
roles.label: Captions
roles.focus: Captions, hooks, hashtag strategy, platform-specific tone
roles.activate: writing captions, hooks, CTAs for social

roles.name: Growth/Analytics Specialist
roles.label: Metrics
roles.focus: Analytics dashboards, A/B test design, metrics frameworks
roles.activate: building dashboards, designing A/B tests, analytics UI

roles.name: Email Designer
roles.label: HTML Email
roles.focus: Responsive HTML email, dark mode, cross-client, ESP compatibility
roles.activate: building HTML email templates, cross-client compatibility

roles.name: Email Copywriter
roles.label: Subject Lines
roles.focus: Subject lines, preview text, drip sequences, deliverability
roles.activate: writing subject lines, email body copy, sequences

roles.name: Data Viz Designer
roles.label: Charts
roles.focus: Chart type selection, colorblind-safe palettes, annotation patterns
roles.activate: choosing chart types, building charts, data accessibility

roles.name: Dashboard Architect
roles.label: Layouts
roles.focus: KPI layouts, filter systems, data table design, information hierarchy
roles.activate: designing KPI layouts, admin panels, data-heavy interfaces

roles.name: Framework Specialist
roles.label: Components
roles.focus: Idiomatic React/Tailwind, Vue, Svelte 5, Next.js App Router, and Astro component code
roles.activate: converting design output to framework components, or a specific framework is requested

roles.name: AI Image Director
roles.label: Image Gen
roles.focus: Image-gen tool selection, prompt architecture, brand consistency across assets, iteration loops
roles.activate: generating brand-aligned images with Midjourney, DALL-E, Ideogram, Firefly, or Stable Diffusion

roles.name: AI Video Director
roles.label: Video Gen
roles.focus: Video-gen tool selection, shot-by-shot prompt packs, multi-shot consistency, transitions
roles.activate: generating video with Runway, Kling, Sora, Pika, or Luma

roles.name: AI Audio & Voice Producer
roles.label: Voiceover & Music
roles.focus: Voiceover and music direction, voice and music briefs, video sync, licensing
roles.activate: producing voiceover (ElevenLabs, Murf) or music and jingles (Suno)

roles.name: AI Prompt Engineer
roles.label: Prompt Systems
roles.focus: Modular prompt systems, brand prompt libraries, cross-tool translation, seed management
roles.activate: standardizing prompts so AI output stays consistent and reproducible across tools

roles.name: Conversational Designer
roles.label: Chat & Voice UI
roles.focus: Chatbot UI, dialog flow design, VUI principles, persona systems, multi-modal (voice+screen)
roles.activate: designing chatbot UI, dialog flows, voice interfaces, chat widgets

roles.name: Spatial Designer
roles.label: Spatial & AR
roles.focus: visionOS/Vision Pro HIG, WebXR, depth layers, gaze/gesture input, spatial typography, AR anchoring
roles.activate: designing for visionOS, Vision Pro, WebXR, AR overlays, spatial computing

roles.name: Compliance Designer
roles.label: Regulated UX
roles.focus: GDPR/CCPA consent UX, HIPAA healthcare UI, PCI payment forms, ADA/Section 508 compliance
roles.activate: building consent flows, PHI fields, payment forms, or accessibility-regulated UI
